meta.title: The shared build cache is billed until 1 March: someone needs to say keep it or retire it
meta.lede: A shared build cache in the example project has served no builds for sixty days. Its plan renews on 1 March. Nobody has said who owns it. Ticket [r1].
meta.foot: Source: an invented example. Replace every value with your own facts.

deadline.ask_by_note: last sensible day to ask the owner

options.title: Ask the owner, then retire it
options.pro: One question and a record left behind
options.note: No answer by 24 Feb means retire it.

options.title: Renew on purpose
options.con: Needs an owner and a reason
options.note: Only if an owner confirms a planned use.

why: Retiring an unused cache is cheap to undo, while renewing it quietly adds a cost nobody tracks. The one real risk is a hidden user, and a single question closes it [r1].

needs.need: Any pipeline still pointing at it
Keep or retire, in one line

reply.text: Re EX-4: the shared build cache served no builds for 60 days. Unless the owner replies by 24 Feb, please retire it.
